requirements.statement: let users list, read and search the documentation pages through `amond docs`, `amond docs read <page>` and `amond docs search <query>`
include Flue's guide, reference, CLI and SDK pages, and its sandbox, deploy and tooling ecosystem pages, except the pages that depend on packages this repository did not import
include Flue's sandbox and tooling blueprints and the build-from-scratch guides for the sandbox, tooling, channel and database kinds, and list them when `amond add` runs with no arguments
deliver blueprint text to `amond add` and `amond update` from a hosted registry site on an amond-owned domain, which the CLI uses by default, with `AMOND_REGISTRY_URL` overriding that default
publish the included blueprints to that registry site, so that every blueprint the CLI lists can be fetched
leave out the blueprints and pages that depend on packages this repository did not import, and edit the remaining pages that mention those packages so they no longer direct users to them
present every page and blueprint under amond names: packages, the `amond` command, `amond.config.ts`, `AMOND_*` environment variables and `Amond<Name>Agent` classes
credit Flue as the source of the content, following the attribution convention set in #27
record the upstream Flue commit the content was taken from (v2.3.0, `deee93b`)
make every `amond docs read <page>` pointer in the files `amond init` scaffolds resolve to an included page
serve documentation pages without a network connection
fail a registry request within a bounded time with a message that names the registry, instead of hanging
fetch blueprint text by default only over HTTPS from a location the amond project controls, because coding agents act on that text; an `AMOND_REGISTRY_URL` override is the user's own explicit choice
make every `Sandbox` value satisfy `Experimental_SandboxSession` from `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` 5.0.64 directly, with no adapter, wrapper, or cast
keep the framework extensions on `Sandbox`: `cwd`, `resolvePath`, `stat`, `readdir`, `exists`, `mkdir`, and `rm`, with relative paths resolved against `cwd` in every file operation

replace `Sandbox.exec` with the session's `run` and `spawn`, and accept an optional `timeoutMs` on their options that is forwarded to the provider's native deadline where the provider has one, and enforced through an abort signal otherwise

replace the framework's `readFile(path)`, `readFileBuffer(path)`, and `writeFile(path, content)` with the session's `readFile`, `readBinaryFile`, `readTextFile`, `writeFile`, `writeBinaryFile`, and `writeTextFile`, including their contract that a missing file resolves to `null`

keep the existing abort and liveness contract for `run` and `spawn`: a pre-aborted call never executes, a mid-flight abort rejects promptly, an orphaned command's eventual settlement is reported to `onOrphanSettled` when the caller supplies one, and on providers that detect sandbox death, that death rejects with `SandboxDiedError`

deliver `spawn` output live on `local()` and on `cloudflareSandbox` stubs that provide `execStream`, and on completion on `bash()`, driver-backed sandboxes, and `cloudflareSandbox` stubs without `execStream`, with `wait`, `kill`, and abort working on all of them
keep every existing `SandboxDriver` implementation valid without changes, and have `sandboxFromDriver` produce the new `Sandbox` from it
adapt the three built-in providers, `cloudflareSandbox`, `bash()`, and `local()`, to the new `Sandbox`, each with a `description` of its environment
port the built-in tools (read, write, edit, bash, grep, glob) onto the new methods with no change to what the model sees

update every page under `packages/cli/docs` that calls or documents the removed `Sandbox` methods, including the sandbox and agent API references, the sandbox and tool guides, and the Cloudflare, GitHub Actions, and GitLab CI deploy pages, and the `sandbox--cloudflare-computer` blueprint, which implements `Sandbox` directly rather than through `SandboxDriver`
keep the public `session.fs` and `session.shell` unchanged in names, signatures, and behaviour, including `session.fs.readFile` throwing on a missing file
add `@ai-sdk/provider-utils` to `tech-stack.md` before it becomes a dependency of `@amond-ai/agent`
mark the removal of `exec` and the old file-method signatures as a breaking change in the commit history, so release-please records it
cover the new `Sandbox` contract with tests that run on all three built-in providers. `@amond-ai/agent` has no tests today, so these are new
